broad_core_role: global candidate universe and default order; never counted as an expert

families.label: Functional & Homology
families.context_policy: pair-level train-graph context combining the reaction train-known enzyme-neighborhood prototype and the enzyme train-known reaction-neighborhood prototype; identical evidence in R2E and E2R; held-out target edges never enter context
families.context_permission: shared alpha=20; protect Top5; only reorder ranks 6-100; missing evidence is neutral

families.label: Structural & Mechanistic

pocket_interaction.representation: 256-d local pocket-substrate bidirectional cross-attention representation before global ESM/DRFP fusion
pocket_interaction.training: relation-level leave-one-positive-out pairwise ranking with Broad-hard scoreable negatives
pocket_interaction.permission: R2E only; alpha 0.35; Broad/BRIDGE Top20 protected; only scoreable candidates below rank 20 may be locally reordered

families.support_policy: availability alone has no ranking authority; ranking authority comes from the pair-level Pocket-Reaction Interaction score
families.missing_policy: available scoring members only; silent if none

families.label: Domain Specialists
families.policy: R2E family-CAGE/TPS specialists act only under frozen applicability gates; a whole-layer specialist ablation is reported on the edge-wise relation-unseen surface; the current E2R surface does not add family-CAGE/TPS specialists.

relation_visibility.relation_unseen_target: exact relation absent from clean2023; no enzyme-seen or reaction-seen restriction
relation_visibility.known_relation_output_policy: train-known relations for the current query are excluded from discovery output
relation_visibility.seed_context: legacy single-sided seed experiments remain reproducible but are superseded for current reporting by Reciprocal Relation Context
relation_visibility.reciprocal_relation_context: both train-neighborhood prototypes are built from clean2023 only; held-out target edge excluded; missing side neutral
